tei:div.tei:p: /phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gsal byed nor bu'i phreng ba nyams su blang bde ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/

/oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos chu gter chen po yi// snying por gyur pa lnga ldan nor bu'i phreng*// bla ma'i man ngag ded dpon las byung ba// ma nor gsal bar 'dir ni brjod par bya// de yang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam 'di la sngon 'gro thun mong dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro rnams spyi ltar du nyams su len par byed/ thun mong ma yin pa byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgoms la/ lnga ldan gzhung las/ byams dang snying rje'i rta pho la// gzhan phan gyi dkyus thog ma bcad na// khrom lha mi'i 'or che mi 'byung bas// sems sngon 'gro 'di la nan tan mdzod// ces pa las/ dang po byams pa sgom pa 'di ltar bya ste/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan na ci ma rung*/ bde ba dang ldan par bya/ bde ba dang ldan par gyur cig snyam du bsgoms pas/ byams lhang nge song nas 'bral snying mi 'dod pa zhig 'byung ste byams pa skyes pa'o// de ltar snying rje'i dmigs pa ni/ bdag dang bdag cag thams cad la sdang bar byed pa'i dgra/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub par byed pa la bar du gcod pa'i log 'dren bdud dang bdud kyi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso byas pa'i ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral na ci ma rung*/ bral bar bya/ bral bar gyur cig snyam du bsgoms pas/ rang nyid sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'dod pa bzhin du/ sems can thams cad kyang sdug bsngal dang bral na ang snyam pa byung ba ni snying rje skyes pa'o// de ltar byams snying rje skyes kyang*/ byang chub kyi sems ma skyes na mthar thug gi 'bras bu mi 'byung ste/ mnyam med dwags po rin che'i zhal nas/ re zhig sngon 'gro bde ba ste// nges par 'dod pa thar pa yin// zhes pas/ nges par legs pa'i yon tan thob par byed pa la/

byang chub kyi sems bsgom dgos te/ smon 'jug don dam gsum las/ smon pa'i dmigs pa sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las ma brgal ba rnams bsgral bar bya/ ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bya/ nyan rang gi theg pa las ngal ma sos pa rnams dbugs dbyung bar bya'o// yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan 'das kyi sa la 'god par bya snyam du bsgom pa'o// 'jug pa byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i dmigs pa ni/ sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god pa'i don du/ dus de ring nas bzung ste sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du/ lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol/ zab mo lnga ldan gyi rim pa bsgom par bya snyam mo// don dam pa byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa ni/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes la 'jog pa ste/ de ltar bsgoms pa'i phan yon ni/ slob dpon chen po zhi ba lha'i spyod 'jug las/ dge ba gzhan kun chu shing lta bu ste// 'bras bu skyes nas zad par 'gyur ba yin// byang chub sems kyi ljon shing rtag par ni/ 'bras bu 'byin pas mi zad thob par 'gyur// zhes gsungs/ des sngon 'gro song nas/ dngos gzhi sgom pa la/ bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim gnyis las/ dang po bskyed rim bsgom dgos te/ lnga ldan gzhung las/ rang lus lha sku'i rgyal po la// gzhi 'gyur med kyi brtan sa ma zin na// ma mkha' 'gro'i 'khor 'bangs mi 'du bas// lus yi dam gyi lha la nan tan mdzod// ces pas/ bskyed rim mngon byang lngas bskyed byed dgos te/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma 'dab ma 'bum ldan gyi dbus su nyi ma dang zla ba/ de'i steng du rdo rje sngon po lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'khor lo sdom pa lhan cig skyes par gyur pa ni/ sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/

ral pa'i thor gtsug yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang*/ ral pa'i logs g.yas su sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ g.yon du zla ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang zhing*/ phyag rgya drug dang rus pa'i rgyan drug gis spras pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa'i bdag nyid du gnas pa'i pang du/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhal gnyis phyag gnyis mas 'khyud cing*/ yum gyi rtsa zhal dmar mo khro zhal/ steng zhal phag gi gdong can/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal/ rdo rje dang gri gug 'dzin pas snyoms par 'jug pa'i bdag nyid du bsgom/ yab yum gyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par bstim/ slar yang thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros dbang gi lha rigs lnga spyan drangs/ dbang bskur/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ yum la rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan cing*/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang rang nyid la thim par bsgom ste/ ngag tu bzlas pa bya ba ni/ gtso bo'inye snying*/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ yum gyi nye snying*/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces ci mang bzlas pa'i mthar/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ḥlas 'od 'phros snod bcud 'od du zhu yum la thim/ yum yab la thim/ yab thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ zhabs kyu/ khog pa/ mgo bo/ zla tshes/ thig le/ nā da'i bar du thim nas mi dmigs pa'i ngang 'jog de'i ngang nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni/ lnga ldan gzhung las/ bla ma sku bzhi'i gangs ri la// mos gus kyi nyi ma ma shar na// byin rlabs kyi chu rgyun mi 'byung bas// sems mos gus 'di la nan tan mdzod// ces gsungs pas/

rang nyid yi dam du gnas pa'i mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ge brgyad kyi gdan gyi steng du/ pad+ma nyi ma zla ba'i gdan la/ bla ma bstan pa'i bdag po sangs rgyas shākya thub pa mtshan dpe dang ldan pa/ phyag sa gnon dang mnyam bzhag gi steng du lhung bzed rin po ches gang ba bsnams pa/ sku la gur gum sku sha ri'i chos gos gsum dang ldan pa bsnams pa/ dbu'i gtsug gtor ltar mi mngon pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i dkyil mo krung gi bzhugs pa la/ rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor bar bsgoms te/ bdun rnam dag dang maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i ngo bor gyur pa/ bla ma rin po che'i sku la gsol ba 'debs/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi ngo bor gyur pa/ bla ma rin po che'i gsung la gsol ba 'debs/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ bla ma rin po che'i thugs la gsol ba 'debs// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pa'i ngang nas mnyam gzhag bsgom mo// yang rang gi snying gi dbus na rtsa brgyad gnas pa de/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad du bsgom/ rus pa rin po che'i khri/ dkar tshil dang dmar tshil nyi zla'i gdan du bsgoms pa'i steng du ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ rnam pa longs sku rnam par mdzad/ sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam bzhag gi steng du lhung bzed rin po ches gang ba bsnams pa/ dbu rgyan snyan rgyan dar dang rin po che'i rgyan du mas spras pa/ zhabs rdo rje dkyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ sku la 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba'i dpral bar zla gdan la oṃ/ mgrin par pad+ma'i gdan la āḥ thugs khar nyi gdan la hūm̐ gi mtha' mar/ rtsa brgyud bla ma'i gsang mtshan sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba bsgoms nas/ bdun rnam dag byas nas gsol 'debs ni/

rje yid bzhin nor bu gtsug gi rgyan// smra bsam brjod med rgyal ba'i thugs// mkhyen pa'i ye shes lnga dang ldan// brtse ba'i bdag nyid bka' drin can// 'gro ba skyob mdzad rin po che// bdag sems nyid ngang nas gsol ba 'debs// chos nyid ngang du byin gyis rlobs// sems gdod nas skye med rnam dag 'di// blo 'das chos skur rtogs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes brjod nas rtsa brgyud bla ma'i gsang mtshan gyi bzlas pa bya ba ni/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon gu ru badz+ra dhṛ ka sid+dhi pha la bla ma rdo rje 'chang dngos grub bzang po stsol hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon/ gu ru pra dzñā bha dra sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ bla ma ye shes dngos grub bzang po stsol/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon gu ru dzñā na sid+dhi pha la bla ma shes rab bzang po dngos grub bzang po stsol hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon gu ru dharma ma ti sid+dhi pha la bla ma chos kyi blo gros dngos grub bzang po stsol/ hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon gu ru badz+ra ke tuḥsid+dhi pha la bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan dngos grub bzang po stsol hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon gu ru puṇ+ye rat+na sid+dhi pha la bla ma bsod nams rin chen dngos grub bzang po stsol hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon gu ru badz+ra rā dzā sid+dhi pha la bla ma rdo rje rgyal po dngos grub bzang po stsol hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon gu ru rat+na shrī bha dra sid+dhi pha la bla ma rin chen dpal dngos grub bzang po stsol hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/

oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon gu ru puṇ+ye kīrti sid+dhi pha la bla ma bsod rnams grags pa dngos grub bzang po stsol hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon gu ru badz+ra kīrti sid+dhi pha la bla ma rdo rje grags dngos grub bzang po stsol hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon gu ru rat+na sing ha sid+dhi pha la bla ma rin seng ge dngos grub bzang po stsol hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon gu ru kīrti puṇ+ye sid+dhi pha la bla ma grags pa bsod nams dngos grub bzang po stsol hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon gu ru badz+ra rat+na sid+dhi pha la bla ma rdo rje rin chen dngos grub bzang po stsol hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon gu ru badz+ra rā dza sid+dhi pha la bla ma rdo rje rgyal po dngos grub bzang po stsol hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/ oṃ āḥgu ru dharma rā dza sid+dhi pha la bla ma chos kyi rgyal po dngos grub bzang po stsol hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon gu ru ar+tha rā dza sid+dhi pha la bla ma don grub rgyal po dngos grub bzang po stsol hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon gu ru ga ga dh+wa dza sid+dhi pha la bla ma nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dngos grub bzang po stsol hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon gu ru wā gī shwa ra dh+wa dza sid+dhi pha la bla ma ngag dbang rgyal mtshan dngos grub bzang po stsol hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon gu ru wā gī shwa ra kīrti sid+dhi pha la

bla ma ngag dbang rgyal mtshan dngos grub bzang po stsol/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon gu ru wā gī shwa ra kīrti sid+dhi pha la bla ma ngag dbang grags pa dngos grub bzang po stsol hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon gu ru rat+na dharmā dh+wa dza shrī bha dra sid+dhi pha la bla ma rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dngos grub bzang po stsol hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/ oṃ āḥ sku dang gsung gi sa bon gu ru ā nan+da rat+na dharmā dh+wa dza shrī bha dra sid+dhi pha la bla ma kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dngos grub bzang po stsol hūm̐/ thugs kyi sa bon/ zhes bzlas pas bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad la phog pas/ sems can thams cad kyang rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku dpag tu med par gyur bar bsam/ de nas phyi snod kyi bla ma nang bcud kyi bla ma la thim/ nang bcud kyi bla ma snying kha'i bla ma la thim/ de 'od du zhu nas snying kha'i hūm̐ la thim/ de nas hūm̐ zhabs kyu la thim/ zhabs kyu khog pa la thim/ khog pa mgo bo la thim/ mgo bo zla tshes la thim/ zla tshes thig le la thim/ thig le nā da la thim/ nā da mi dmigs pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag bla ma rdo rje 'chang du bsgom pa ni/ rang gi spyi bo'i steng du/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma 'di nyid rigs drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po/ sku mdog sngon po bai ḍūr+ya'i rtse mor nyi ma'i 'od kyi reg pa ltar sngo zhing*/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu thugs khar bsnol thabs su 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje'i dkyil mo krung gi bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ḥthugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/

rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems spyan drangs/ bla ma dang gnyis su med par bstim/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus pa'i bdag nyid du sgom ste/ lus longs spyod dge ba'i rtsa ba/ maṇ+ḍal phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod de/ na mo dus gsum 'khor 'das kyi rgyud yongs su gang ba/ bla ma rin po che'i sku gsung thugs dang*/ bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer mi phyed cing*/ tha mi dad pa'i mos gus dang*/ rtogs pa mchog tu gyur pa skye bar mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi yi ge gsum las 'od zer dkar po dang dmar po sngon po byung bas/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la phog sdig sgrib dag sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ gsang ba dang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob par bsam ste/ ye shes thig le'i rgyud las/ bla ma'i sku yi dkyil 'khor du// dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par zhus// rgyud sde'i dgongs pa gnad kyi mchog /sa lam gyi rim pa ma lus rdzogs// zhes pa'i don yin/ mthar bla ma de nyid 'od du zhu nas rang nyid la thim/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med pa'i ngang la gzhag de'i ngang nas bla ma ngo bo nyid sku bsgom pa ni/ bla ma rin po che chos kyi sku/ lhun gyis grub cing 'dus ma byas/ ngo bo nyid kyi rnam par dag pas/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi bdag la dbang bskur ba dang*/ byin gyis rlabs pa rgya chen po mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod nas/ de nyid kyi ngang las rdzogs rim bsgom pa ni/ lnga ldan gzhung las/ sems nyid kyi nam mkha' yangs pa la// rnam rtog gi sprin tshogs ma dengs na// mkhyen gnyis kyi gza' skar mi bkra bas// sems mi rtog 'di la nan tan mdzod// ces pas/ rnam par rtog pa dengs shing sangs rgyas kyi yon tan bskyed par byed pa la/

rten 'brel lus la bsgrigs pas rtogs pa sems la 'char// zhes pas/ rkang pa rdo rje'i dkyil krung*/ lag pa mnyam gzhag phyag rgya/ lus srang*/ mig rtser zhes pa/ mdun gyi nam mkhar gtad la rnam snang chos bdun ldan gyi gnas par bya/ dmigs pa sems ma bcos par bzhag de ltar bsgoms pas rnam rtog dag cing mi rtog pa rgyas pa/ chos sku thob pa ste/ rje til+li pa'i zhal nas/ lus kyi bya ba yongs thong rnal mar dal bar sdod// ngag la smra brjod ma mang grag stong brag cha 'dra// sems la ci yang mi bsam zla lo'i chos la ltos// ma bcos gnyug ma chos sku'i ngang du zhog /bcings pa glod na grol bar the tshom med// de ltar sems kyi rang bzhin nam mkha' 'dra// chos rnams ma lus de ru ma 'dus med// ces gsungs/ mnyam gzhag de las langs nas/ bsngo ba byed dgos te/ lnga ldan gzhung las/ tshogs gnyis yid bzhin gyi nor bu la// smon lam gyis byi dor ma byas na// dgos 'dod kyi 'bras bu mi 'byung bas// rjes bsngo ba 'di la nan tan mdzod// ces pas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ge dang pad zla'i steng du/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang sems rnams bsngo ba'i dpang por bzhugs par bsgoms la/ bsngo ba bdag dang 'khor 'das zhes pa/ bsngo rgyu'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dus gsum du bsags pa dang*/ gshis la gnas pa'i dge rtsa rnams so// bsngo ba de sems can thams cad la'o// thob bya de 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang du bsngo ba yin te/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan bsngo ba'i le'u las/ 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dang*// bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por reg gyur cig /ces pa'i don no// de ltar rgyu'i rtsa ba byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa/ gsang sngags kyi snying po yi dam gyi lha bsgom pa dang*/ yon tan gyi snying po bla ma bsgom pa dang*/

don gyi snying po phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa dang*/ 'bras bu'i snying po bsngo ba byed pa ste/ dam pa'i chos lnga ldan gyi khrid kyi rim pa'o// bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dpal la longs spyod cing*// don gnyis 'bras bu'i go 'phang mchog thob pa// rim gnyis lnga ldan gsal byed nor bu'i phreng*// bsam grub dpal mo'i mtshan can rnal 'byor du// ā nan rat+na bdag gis lhag bsam gyi// dge don 'phel phyir bkod des rgyal dbang mchog nyid thob gyur cig// /
